items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And when I joined the band, he wasn't with the band, but he came back with the band shortly afterwards, after I was there.

ctx.x: I don't know. But now that we're on singers, what other singers have you worked with who were memorable to you?

Well, Pha Terrell I liked a lot. I thought the world of him, because he sang so pretty, man, you know. It ain't every day that you run across a guy that can really sing, sing pretty. And everybody loved him. But Pha was one of those kind of guys... And when I joined the band, he wasn't with the band, but he came back with the band shortly afterwards, after I was there.
